+package com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker
+
+import android.content.ActivityNotFoundException
+import android.content.Intent
+import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultRegistry
+import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContract
+import androidx.core.app.ActivityOptionsCompat
+import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
+
+/** Records launches instead of starting activities, so the test can deliver the result itself. */
+internal class RecordingActivityResultRegistry : ActivityResultRegistry() {
+    private class Launch(val requestCode: Int, val contract: ActivityResultContract<*, *>, val input: Any?)
+
+    private val launches = mutableListOf<Launch>()
+
+    /** When false, launches fail the way they do on devices with the documents app disabled. */
+    var hasDocumentsApp = true
+
+    override fun <I, O> onLaunch(
+        requestCode: Int,
+        contract: ActivityResultContract<I, O>,
+        input: I,
+        options: ActivityOptionsCompat?,
+    ) {
+        if (!hasDocumentsApp) throw ActivityNotFoundException("No activity for the documents intent")
+        launches += Launch(requestCode, contract, input)
+    }
+
+    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
+    fun lastIntent(): Intent {
+        val launch = launches.last()
+        val contract = launch.contract as ActivityResultContract<Any?, *>
+        return contract.createIntent(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext(), launch.input)
+    }
+
+    fun dispatchLast(result: Any?) {
+        dispatchResult(launches.last().requestCode, result)
+    }
+}

+import android.net.Uri
+import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.Saver
+import com.mohamedrejeb.calf.io.KmpFile
+
+/** What a file saver writes once the user has picked where to save it. */
+internal sealed interface SaveSource {
+    class Bytes(val bytes: ByteArray) : SaveSource
+
+    class File(val file: KmpFile) : SaveSource
+}
+
+/**
+ * Holds the source of the save in flight between `launch` and the system result.
+ *
+ * The system save sheet pauses and resumes the activity, so the result is handled by a later
+ * composition than the one that launched the save. The source therefore lives in this holder,
+ * which every composition shares, rather than in a composition-local variable.
+ */
+internal class PendingSaveSource {
+    private var source: SaveSource? = null
+
+    fun set(source: SaveSource) {
+        this.source = source
+    }
+
+    /** Returns the pending source and clears it, so a result is never written twice. */
+    fun take(): SaveSource? = source.also { source = null }
+
+    companion object {
+        /**
+         * Keeps a pending file across process death by its URI. Pending bytes are not saved: they
+         * can be larger than the saved instance state allows.
+         */
+        val Saver: Saver<PendingSaveSource, String> = Saver(
+            save = { holder -> (holder.source as? SaveSource.File)?.file?.uri?.toString() },
+            restore = { uri -> PendingSaveSource().apply { set(SaveSource.File(KmpFile(Uri.parse(uri)))) } },
+        )
+    }
+}

+package com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker

+import platform.Foundation.NSURL
+import platform.UIKit.UIAdaptivePresentationControllerDelegateProtocol
+import platform.UIKit.UIDocumentPickerDelegateProtocol
+import platform.UIKit.UIDocumentPickerViewController
+import platform.UIKit.UIPresentationController
+import platform.UIKit.presentationController
+import platform.darwin.NSObject
+import kotlin.concurrent.AtomicInt
+
+/**
+ * Delegate of a presented [UIDocumentPickerViewController] that reports exactly one outcome per
+ * presentation.
+ *
+ * A dismissal can arrive through `documentPickerWasCancelled`, through
+ * `presentationControllerDidDismiss` alone (a swipe that starts before the presentation animation
+ * ends fires only that one), or through both, so every callback goes through one guard.
+ */
+internal class DocumentPickerDelegate(
+    private val onPicked: (List<NSURL>) -> Unit,
+    private val onCancelled: () -> Unit,
+) : NSObject(), UIDocumentPickerDelegateProtocol, UIAdaptivePresentationControllerDelegateProtocol {
+    private val finished = AtomicInt(0)
+
+    /** Arms this delegate for a new presentation of [picker]; call it before presenting. */
+    fun attachTo(picker: UIDocumentPickerViewController) {
+        finished.value = 0
+        picker.delegate = this
+        picker.presentationController?.delegate = this
+    }
+
+    override fun documentPicker(
+        controller: UIDocumentPickerViewController,
+        didPickDocumentsAtURLs: List<*>,
+    ) {
+        if (finishOnce()) onPicked(didPickDocumentsAtURLs.filterIsInstance<NSURL>())
+    }
+
+    override fun documentPickerWasCancelled(controller: UIDocumentPickerViewController) {
+        if (finishOnce()) onCancelled()
+    }
+
+    override fun presentationControllerDidDismiss(presentationController: UIPresentationController) {
+        if (finishOnce()) onCancelled()
+    }
+
+    private fun finishOnce(): Boolean = finished.compareAndSet(0, 1)
+}

+package com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker
+
+import com.mohamedrejeb.calf.core.InternalCalfApi
+import com.mohamedrejeb.calf.io.KmpFile
+import com.mohamedrejeb.calf.io.withSecurityScopedAccess
+import kotlinx.cinterop.ExperimentalForeignApi
+import platform.Foundation.NSData

+import platform.Foundation.NSTemporaryDirectory
+import platform.Foundation.NSURL
+import platform.Foundation.NSUUID
+import platform.Foundation.URLByDeletingLastPathComponent
+import platform.Foundation.writeToURL
+
+/**
+ * Files Calf copies to or from a system sheet are staged in the app's temporary directory, each in
+ * a directory of its own, so they keep their real name without colliding with each other.
+ */
+@OptIn(ExperimentalForeignApi::class)
+private fun stagingUrl(area: String, fileName: String): NSURL {
+    val directory = "${NSTemporaryDirectory().removeSuffix("/")}/$area/${NSUUID().UUIDString}"
+    NSFileManager.defaultManager.createDirectoryAtPath(
+        directory,
+        withIntermediateDirectories = true,
+        attributes = null,
+        error = null,
+    )
+    return NSURL.fileURLWithPath("$directory/$fileName")
+}
+
+/**
+ * Copies a picked file while the picker still grants access to it. The copy keeps the picked
+ * file's name, so `KmpFile.url` is readable for as long as the app needs it and its path still
+ * ends in the real name.
+ *
+ * @return The copy, or `null` if [source] could not be copied.
+ */
+internal fun stagePickedFile(source: NSURL): NSURL? {
+    val fileName = source.lastPathComponent ?: return null
+    return copyToStaging(source, stagingUrl(PICKER_STAGING_AREA, fileName))
+}
+
+/** The picked files that could be staged, and the failure to report for those that could not. */
+internal class StagedPick(val files: List<KmpFile>, val failure: FilePickerException?)
+
+/** Stages each picked URL; see [stagePickedFile]. */
+internal fun stagePickedUrls(urls: List<NSURL>): StagedPick {
+    val files = urls.mapNotNull { it.toStagedKmpFile() }
+    return StagedPick(files, partialPickFailure(failed = urls.size - files.size, picked = urls.size))
+}
+
+/** A [KmpFile] that reads from a staged copy of this picked URL and reports the URL as its origin. */
+@OptIn(InternalCalfApi::class)
+internal fun NSURL.toStagedKmpFile(): KmpFile? =
+    stagePickedFile(this)?.let { copy -> KmpFile(url = copy, originalUrl = this) }
+
+/**
+ * Writes [data] to a fresh export staging directory as [fileName]. The export picker shows, and
+ * saves under, the staged file's own name, which is why the name is the one the caller asked for.
+ *
+ * @return The staged file, or `null` if it could not be written.
+ */
+internal fun stageExportData(data: NSData, fileName: String): NSURL? {
+    val url = stagingUrl(SAVER_STAGING_AREA, fileName)
+    if (data.writeToURL(url, atomically = true)) return url
+    removeStaging(url)
+    return null
+}
+
+/**
+ * Copies [source] into a fresh export staging directory as [fileName]; the source is left in place.
+ *
+ * @return The staged copy, or `null` if [source] could not be copied.
+ */
+internal fun stageExportFile(source: NSURL, fileName: String): NSURL? =
+    copyToStaging(source, stagingUrl(SAVER_STAGING_AREA, fileName))
+
+@OptIn(ExperimentalForeignApi::class, InternalCalfApi::class)
+private fun copyToStaging(source: NSURL, destination: NSURL): NSURL? {
+    val copied = source.withSecurityScopedAccess {
+        NSFileManager.defaultManager.copyItemAtURL(source, toURL = destination, error = null)
+    }
+    if (copied) return destination
+    removeStaging(destination)
+    return null
+}
+
+/** Removes a staged file together with its private directory. */
+@OptIn(ExperimentalForeignApi::class)
+internal fun removeStaging(stagedUrl: NSURL) {
+    val directory = stagedUrl.URLByDeletingLastPathComponent ?: return
+    NSFileManager.defaultManager.removeItemAtURL(directory, error = null)
+}
+
+private const val PICKER_STAGING_AREA = "calf-file-picker"
+private const val SAVER_STAGING_AREA = "calf-file-saver"
